about: The airline sandbox of the 5 November 2026 flow review, loaded with ATLAN_EMULATOR_ANALYTICS=1: ten released metrics in sqlite, three saved queries (one rejected), one ontology release with 89 records, and no warehouse SQL tool.

tools.name: extension__metric__search_metrics
tools.description: Find metric definitions in one workspace, or released ones across all of yours, ranked by relevance to `query` (or resolved exactly by `name`, which needs `workspace_id`). With include_definition=true, rank published revisions with release receipts and bounded native definitions, including opaque formula, filters, source SQL and unit. No SQL is executed.

tools.name: extension__metric__search_queries
tools.description: Find published saved SQL queries in one workspace, or across all of yours when workspace_id is omitted. Rank released queries by question; a ranked call without include_sql carries SQL for the top result only. An exact `name` needs `workspace_id`.

tools.name: extension__ontology__get_records
tools.description: Retrieve caller-visible records that were valid at a business-time instant. Results retain exact ontology, type, relationship, and document-version evidence. The tool does not query warehouse rows and reports when its bounded scan is truncated.

tools.name: extension__ontology__get_context
tools.description: Return the smallest relevant subgraph from one exact immutable ontology release.

metric_01evalm01.name: turnaround_time
metric_01evalm01.description: Average minutes between a leg's on-block arrival and the next departure of the same aircraft, for scheduled departures on time-critical rotations.

definition.population: Scheduled passenger flight legs operated by the airline
exclusions: the aircraft's last leg of the day

source.sql: SELECT avg((julianday(fl.next_off_block) - julianday(fl.on_block)) * 1440) FROM flight_leg fl JOIN station s ON fl.departure_station_id = s.station_id WHERE fl.status <> 'cancelled' AND fl.service_type = 'scheduled'

examples.question: Turnaround time for March 2026
examples.sql: SELECT avg((julianday(fl.next_off_block) - julianday(fl.on_block)) * 1440) FROM flight_leg fl JOIN station s ON fl.departure_station_id = s.station_id WHERE fl.status <> 'cancelled' AND fl.service_type = 'scheduled' AND strftime('%Y-%m', scheduled_departure) = '2026-03'

metric_01evalm08.name: otp_d15
metric_01evalm08.description: Departure punctuality: share of scheduled departures that leave within 15 minutes of schedule.

definition.population: Scheduled passenger flight legs operated by the airline

source.sql: SELECT 1.0 * sum(CASE WHEN (julianday(fl.off_block) - julianday(fl.scheduled_departure)) * 1440 <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) FROM flight_leg fl JOIN station s ON fl.departure_station_id = s.station_id WHERE fl.status <> 'cancelled' AND fl.service_type = 'scheduled'
